_note: Frozen inputs of the 90 trajectories of the M4.3 turn-8 replay bank (Commons v1, condition tradeoff_v8, prompt protocol v8, action feedback on). actions[t] lists the moves of turn t in seat order (agent_1, agent_2, agent_3); replaying them from (seed, scenario_id) rebuilds every state. The digests are the values recorded by the research harness. instruction_variant is the reader instruction paraphrase the forecast suite assigned to the trajectory. Exported by scripts/check_equivalence_v1.py --write-data.

digest_recipes.state_sha256: sha256 of json.dumps(state, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), default=str)
digest_recipes.observation_sha256: sha256 of json.dumps(observation, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), default=str)
